modelOverview: Introduced in 2021, the Calatrava ref. 6119 gave the archetypal round dress watch a refreshed, slightly larger 39mm case with a guilloché "Clous de Paris" (hobnail) bezel, a design detail borrowed from Patek Philippe's own archive references. It runs the manually wound Calibre 30-255 PS with a small seconds sub-dial, and has been produced in white gold and rose gold cases with charcoal-grey/black or opaline dials on alligator leather straps.

6119G-001.movement: Manual-wind · Patek Philippe Calibre 30-255 PS · 164 parts, 27 jewels · 28,800 vph · min. 65h power reserve
6119G-001.materials: 18k white gold case on a black alligator leather strap with square scales, white gold prong buckle
6119G-001.bezel: Guilloché "Clous de Paris" (hobnail) bezel in white gold
6119G-001.dial: Charcoal-grey/ebony black dial with vertical satin finish, applied white gold faceted "obus"-style hour markers and dauphine hands, small seconds sub-dial at 6 o'clock
6119G-001.description: The Calatrava 6119 in white gold pairs the model's signature guilloché hobnail bezel with a deep charcoal-grey dial and hand-wound Calibre 30-255 PS visible through a sapphire caseback. Confirmed against Patek Philippe's official site (patek.com) as ref. 6119G-001.

variants.White Gold – Charcoal Grey: 6119G-001 in 18k white gold on a black alligator strap with the charcoal-grey vertical satin dial and white gold hobnail-guilloché bezel, the standard hand-wound white gold execution of the Calatrava 6119.
